messages:
maria_sales: FYI the Novaris exec paused the pilot — main blockers are VPC peering + BYO-KMS + a quick pricing/throughput estimate. They want a clear next-steps email by EOD Fri. Can we triage? :exclamation:

sam_se: On it. Their questions: 1) Can we support BYO-KMS for the Private deployment? 2) Throughput SLA for 8k tokens/sec across 2 concurrent streams? 3) Cost for ~100M tokens/mo on a reserved Dedicated pool. @andy_eng any red flags for peering?

andy_eng: No technical showstoppers. For peering we need their VPC CIDR, a contact to set routes, and a small test IP to validate. Quick test we can ask them to run: `curl -sS https://vpc-test.redwood.ai/ping` from their subnet. If that returns `pong` peering is likely OK. 

rachel_sec: BYO-KMS is supported for Private but we require a key-attestation doc + a KMS access plan (who rotates, who has admin). I'll start the security questionnaire addendum (Q16/Q17 items). We also need to know whether their keys are HSM-backed.

jess_legal: I can draft the BYO-KMS addendum and a limited SLA clause. Note: do not promise latency guarantees beyond the Dedicated tier. Proposed line: "Customer-specific SLAs require a Dedicated contract and defined model/region; otherwise Redwood provides commercially reasonable efforts." Will circulate a short redline.

aaron_ops: I can provision a 2-GPU Dedicated pilot pool for 4 weeks as an interim for testing. Cost uplift ~= +20% vs shared hosted. Provision ETA is ~48 hours after contract sign + networking info. We can also enable temporary burst capacity if they need more TPS.

sam_se: Draft email to customer (please review):
```
Hi Chris / Novaris team,

Thanks for the flag — we want to get the pilot moving quickly. Next steps we need from you:
1) VPC CIDR and a point-of-contact to kick off peering (name + email + Slack handle).
2) KMS contact and whether keys are HSM-backed; confirm you're comfortable with a BYO-KMS addendum.
3) Confirmation of POC acceptance criteria (throughput target, latency budget, and sample prompt set).

On our side: we can provision a short Dedicated pilot (2 GPUs) within ~48h after contract + networking info; Rachel will start the security addendum; Jess will produce BYO-KMS terms; Andy will run the peering validation.

If that plan works, we’ll send a short SOW + invoice for the reserved pilot capacity.

Thanks,
Sam (Redwood Solutions)
```

maria_sales: Good. Small edits: call out target TPS = 8k tokens/sec and mention rollback plan if perf suffers. Also can we include rough monthly cost ballpark so they know order of magnitude?

aaron_ops: Ballpark for 100M tokens/mo on a 2-GPU reserved pilot with caching = ~$18k/mo, + BYO-KMS integration fee one-time ~$3k, plus a potential +20% for isolation. I'll write exact numbers in the SOW.

rachel_sec: Also asking Novaris for SOC2 attestation PDF and the list of users who will access KMS.

jess_legal: I'll attach a one-page redline for BYO-KMS and a sample limited SLA. Will post by EOD.

deploy-bot: Provision request created: PR-8347 — dedicated-pilot/novaris. Link: https://infra.redwood.ai/requests/PR-8347 :white_check_mark:

sam_se: Thanks all. Action items: 
- Maria to send customer email once we add TPS & rollback line (due: today end of day) — maria_sales
- Andy to prepare peering checklist & test URL (due: tomorrow noon) — andy_eng
- Rachel to start security addendum + request SOC2 (due: tomorrow EOD) — rachel_sec
- Jess to produce BYO-KMS redline (due: today EOD) — jess_legal
- Aaron to confirm final cost and provisioning ETA (due: tomorrow morning) — aaron_ops

maria_sales: I'll send the email after edits. Will loop in Novaris CTO + infra lead. Thanks team :pray:
